interpretation: Both arms began with the same source, grammar/choices, feedback, evaluation, Gooo policy and budget limits.
Both promoted one actual failed root-input case into source selection. Subsequent source contracts therefore reflect adaptive feedback.
The deterministic arm recorded 13 selection attempts over three rounds; the model arm recorded six over two rounds. Counts include repeated candidates across rounds and exclude replay/preflight work.
All seven feedback inputs and all three final-evaluation inputs matched their named output expectations after selection.
The final evaluation was not provided to the policy or constructor. Model-training exposure is unknown; this is one previously used task family.
One deterministic-first pair without cache reset does not establish a general speed, memory, or correctness advantage.
Host CPU utilization was not sampled. Command CPU time, maximum RSS, native process records, and individual model timings are retained.
An additional regression records PROGRESS 0/2 when the existing nested-hole grammar cannot express the required constant; expanding budget or cases does not imply general completion.
